text: For Jehovah{H3068} will have compassion{H7355} on Jacob,{H3290} and will yet choose{H977} Israel,{H3478} and set{H3240} them in their own land:{H127} and the sojourner{H1616} shall join{H3867} himself with them, and they shall cleave{H5596} to the house{H1004} of Jacob.{H3290}
